extension.name: Vurnix Honest Gate
extension.description: Deterministic three-state honest gate for AI-written code: compile + phantom-import + honest test count, executed as code — not agent self-review. PASS/BLOCK/UNPROVEN by exit code.
extension.author: shiersa

commands.name: speckit.vurnix.gate
commands.description: Execute the deterministic honest gate over the implementation and relay its verdict verbatim — the agent runs the script; it never grades the code itself

hooks.prompt: Run the deterministic Vurnix honest gate over the implementation?
hooks.description: One script call, one machine verdict: PASS / BLOCK / UNPROVEN
